#Source

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(missRanger)
setwd("~/Desktop/PERMSoDT")
source(file.path("R", "ipw_permanova.R"))
source(file.path("R", "ipw_pcoa.R"))
```


# Ocean
```{r}
load("Ocean.RData")

ps_filtered <- subset_samples(ps, Layer != "MIX")
covar <- c("Oxygen", "ChlorophyllA", "Carbon.total", "NO2NO3", "PAR.PC", "Latitude", "Brunt.Väisälä", "Gradient.Surface.temp.SST.","Depth.nominal", "Temperature")
meta <- as(sample_data(ps_filtered),"matrix")
meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
meta[, covar] <- lapply(meta[, covar], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
set.seed(2025)
imputed_meta <- missRanger(meta[, covar], pmm.k = 3, maxiter = 10, num.trees = 100)
meta[, covar] <- imputed_meta
sample_data(ps_filtered) <- sample_data(meta)

ps_filt <- ps_filtered
```

## Depth nominal

### Bray-Curtis
```{r}
Depth.nominal_filt <- as.numeric(sample_data(ps_filt)[["Depth.nominal"]])
otu = otu_table(ps_filt)
if (taxa_are_rows(otu_table(ps_filt))) otu <- t(otu)
dist_bray_filt <- vegan::vegdist(otu, method = "bray")
meta = as(sample_data(ps_filt), "data.frame")
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ Depth.nominal_filt, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ Depth.nominal_filt + Latitude + Temperature + ChlorophyllA + Gradient.Surface.temp.SST. + Brunt.Väisälä + Oxygen, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
ipw_permanova(dist_bray_filt,Depth.nominal_filt,meta[,c("Latitude", "Temperature", "ChlorophyllA", "Gradient.Surface.temp.SST.", "Brunt.Väisälä", "Oxygen")], family = "gaussian")$p_value

### PCoA
pcoa_res <- vegan::wcmdscale(dist_bray_filt, eig = TRUE, k = 2)   
scores   <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCo1","PCo2")
scores$Group <- Depth.nominal_filt

eig  <- pcoa_res$eig
prop <- eig[eig > 0] / sum(eig[eig > 0])
xlab <- sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", 100*prop[1])
ylab <- sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", 100*prop[2])

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Group") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

### IPW-PCoA
ipw <- ipw_pcoa(dist_bray_filt, x = Depth.nominal_filt, z = meta[,c("Latitude", "Temperature", "ChlorophyllA", "Gradient.Surface.temp.SST.", "Brunt.Väisälä", "Oxygen")], k = 2, family = "gaussian")

scores <- as.data.frame(ipw$scores)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")
scores$Group <- Depth.nominal_filt

xlab <- sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * ipw$prop_explained[1])
ylab <- sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * ipw$prop_explained[2])

ggplot(scores, aes(PCo1, PCo2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Group",
       title = "IPW-adjusted PCoA (balanced on confounders)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

### Aitchison
```{r}

scores   <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCo1","PCo2")
```
```{r}
scores$Group <- Temperature_filt

eig  <- pcoa_res$eig
prop <- eig[eig > 0] / sum(eig[eig > 0])
xlab <- sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", 100*prop[1])
ylab <- sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", 100*prop[2])

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) + 
  labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Group") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

### IPW-PCoA
ipw <- ipw_pcoa(dist_bray_filt, x = Temperature_filt, z = meta[,c("Latitude", "Temperature", "ChlorophyllA", "Gradient.Surface.temp.SST.", "Brunt.Väisälä", "Oxygen")], k = 2)

scores <- as.data.frame(ipw$scores)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")
scores$Group <- Temperature_filt

xlab <- sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * ipw$prop_explained[1])
ylab <- sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * ipw$prop_explained[2])

ggplot(scores, aes(PCo1, PCo2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Group",
       title = "IPW-adjusted PCoA (balanced on confounders)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

## ChlorophyllA

### Bray-Curtis
```{r}
ChlorophyllA_filt <- as.numeric(sample_data(ps_filt)[["ChlorophyllA"]])
otu = otu_table(ps_filt)
if (taxa_are_rows(otu_table(ps_filt))) otu <- t(otu)
dist_bray_filt <- vegan::vegdist(otu, method = "bray")
meta = as(sample_data(ps_filt), "data.frame")
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ ChlorophyllA_filt, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ ChlorophyllA_filt + Depth.nominal + Latitude + Temperature + Gradient.Surface.temp.SST. + Brunt.Väisälä + Oxygen, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
ipw_permanova(dist_bray_filt,ChlorophyllA_filt,meta[,c("Depth.nominal", "Latitude", "Temperature", "Gradient.Surface.temp.SST.", "Brunt.Väisälä", "Oxygen")])$p_value
```

### Aitchison

# Tumor

```{r}
load("physeq_tumor.RData")
physeq_lts_sts <- subset_samples(
  physeq.tree,
  !is.na(group) & (grepl("^LTS", group) | grepl("^STS", group))
)

sample_data(physeq_lts_sts)$group <- factor(
  ifelse(grepl("^LTS", sample_data(physeq_lts_sts)$group), "LTS", "STS"),
  levels = c("LTS", "STS")
)
physeq_lts_sts <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq_lts_sts) > 0, physeq_lts_sts)
sample_data(physeq_lts_sts)$sequencedepth <- sample_sums(physeq_lts_sts)
```


## group

### Bray-Curtis

```{r}
group_filt <- (sample_data(physeq_lts_sts)[["group"]])
otu = otu_table(physeq_lts_sts)
if (taxa_are_rows(otu_table(physeq_lts_sts))) otu <- t(otu)
dist_bray_filt <- vegan::vegdist(otu, method = "bray")
meta = as(sample_data(physeq_lts_sts), "data.frame")
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ group_filt, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(dist_bray_filt ~ group_filt + Cohort + sequencedepth, data=meta, permutations=999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
ipw_permanova(dist_bray_filt,group_filt,meta[,c("Cohort", "sequencedepth")], family = "gaussian")$p_value
```
